ir.name: loss_pairwise_regret_weighted_logsigmoid_cost_gap_repaired
ir.intuition: Preserves probabilistic preference loss weighted by regret and cost gap, safely handling missing weights and clamping sums for stability.
ir.pseudocode:
eps=1e-6
lpw=batch['log_prob_w']
lpl=batch['log_prob_l']
cost_gap=batch['cost_gap']
delta_regret=batch.get('delta_regret', ones_like(lpw))
weight=batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
regret_weight=relu(delta_regret)
log_diff=lpw - lpl
sigmoid_loss=-logsigmoid(log_diff)
weighted_loss=sigmoid_loss * abs(cost_gap) * regret_weight * weight
loss=sum(weighted_loss) / clamp(sum(weight), eps, inf)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    delta_regret = batch.get('delta_regret', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    regret_weight = ops.relu(delta_regret)
    log_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    sigmoid_loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(log_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(sigmoid_loss, ops.abs(cost_gap))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, regret_weight)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, weight)
    weight_sum = ops.clamp(ops.sum(weight), eps, 1e10)
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), weight_sum)
    return loss
